summary: Iter 22 — Verified backend POST /api/i18n/translate-batch (7/7 pytest passing) and frontend DOM auto-translator. Confirmed Settings page, Premium page, bottom nav, and chat input placeholder all translate to English when lovreski_lang='en' is set BEFORE React initializes. Preserved tokens (₽, +79780369381, 'Al Amin Dewan') are intact. Chat message bodies (.no-translate) remain untranslated as intended. RU restore via LanguageSheet works. FR switch via LanguageSheet was inconclusive due to a timing/persistence issue (see below).

integration_issues.flow: Language switch to French via LanguageSheet
integration_issues.issue: After clicking data-testid='lang-fr', localStorage.lovreski_lang did NOT change to 'fr' (remained 'en' or reverted). Subsequent navigation to /settings still rendered in English rather than French. Suspected race: onSelect calls setShowLang(false) which unmounts the sheet, then awaits setLang(l.code). The `setLang` -> `load('fr')` fetches /api/i18n/fr which returns {lang:'fr'} on success; if server returns a fallback lang (e.g., 'en' or 'ru'), that overwrites LS. Also, on subsequent test runs, user.language_pref set from earlier switch to 'ru' overrides localStorage 'en' at login (i18n.jsx line 131-135). This causes stale/wrong lang on re-visits.

action_items: Investigate why setLang('fr') via LanguageSheet does not persist localStorage to 'fr'. Verify GET /api/i18n/fr response actually returns lang='fr' and not a fallback. Consider awaiting the PUT /profile { language_pref } before closing the sheet, or capturing errors from load().

Consider making i18n.jsx prefer localStorage over user.language_pref on initial load OR sync only when user explicitly changes it, to avoid the profile pref clobbering the local selection across sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.jsx line 131-135: user.language_pref sync forces override of localStorage on every auth-me load. This can undo a just-set language on next mount if profile PUT is delayed or user changes lang while offline.

i18n.jsx line 111-125: load() writes localStorage even on failure/fallback (setLangState(data.lang)). If backend LLM fails and returns lang='ru', it silently reverts the user's selection. Should probably surface an error toast to user (already partially done via r.actualLang check in SettingsPage onSelect).
i18n.jsx flush() catch block clears pending but doesn't retry — a transient network error will permanently leave those strings untranslated for the session (until next scan re-enqueues them).
server.py i18n_translate_batch: correctly caps at 200 and dedupes; fail-open behaves correctly.
test_credentials: testuser1@lovreski.ru / password123 — used via API login + addInitScript to seed localStorage before React mount
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL setup detail: You MUST use page.add_init_script() to set localStorage.lovreski_lang BEFORE navigation. Setting localStorage via page.evaluate() AFTER goto() will NOT work — React reads localStorage in useState initializer on first mount. Also note: user.language_pref on the backend profile persists across sessions and OVERRIDES localStorage on auth-me (i18n.jsx effect at line 131-135). If a previous test set language_pref='ru' on testuser1, subsequent runs will revert to 'ru'. To fully reset, PUT /api/profile with {language_pref: null} before testing, or use a fresh user. Backend translate-batch endpoint is fully working, caches in db.i18n_dynamic keyed by sha256[:20]. Auto-translator debounces 220ms and calls POST /i18n/translate-batch in background; wait ~10-15s after initial page load on a fresh language for the LLM batch to complete.
